name: Jedify
description:
Jedify gives you and your AI agents a governed context layer over your organization’s data and knowledge. It connects metrics, entities, business rules, terminology, and source systems into a living Context Graph, so agents can reason, answer, and act with the right business meaning, without users needing to know where the underlying data lives.
The context stays synchronized as your data and business logic change, helping agents deliver more accurate, consistent, and trustworthy results across analytical and agentic workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jedify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jedify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://be.jedify.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jedify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jedify lists 16 MCP tools, including ask_a_research_question, ask_a_single_question, ask_an_agent, ask_questions, check_question_status, contextualize, create_share_link, data_collection_strategy, get_questions_data, get_semantic_layer_entities, list_agents, and logout.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jedify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jedify in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Jedify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jedify is developed by Jedify. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
